cards.description: Attributable, avoidably unresolved accepted commitments over the eligible commitments due in the responsible scope, with a ceiling, so a seat answers for the promises it never let the world settle. A commitment not yet due is not in the sample; documented external unobservability without owner fault, and events the seat never committed to observe, are excluded; no eligible sample is unmeasured, never zero. Accountability is the commitment owner, including responsibility delegated at acceptance. Explicitly provisional: replace, reprice or remove it.
